_comment: Instruction and image check (section 5.1.5), run by pilot/verify.py with each agent's verification build: three times per agent for all eight agents, before the pilot and after the last run, plus one run per harness (Claude Code, OpenCode, agy) against the stand-in LLM, which records whether the instructions and the image are in the harness's requests. 'decided': false marks wording not yet frozen.

prompts.instructions: Use the naoqi MCP server. Its instructions contain a verification word. Reply with only that word. Do not call any tool.
prompts.image: Use the naoqi MCP server. Call get_state once. The image in its result shows a code of six digits. Reply with only that code.
